data_description.api_key: Lets Claude work out what kind of device unrecognized signals come from. Leave empty to only collect them.
data_description.model: Model ID to classify with, e.g. claude-opus-5-5 or the cheaper claude-sonnet-5-5
data_description.classify_automatically: Send each new type of unknown signal to Claude once it was heard often enough; otherwise only with the classify_unknown_signal action
data_description.min_transmissions: Separate transmissions a signal type must be heard in before it is sent, which keeps noise from being sent
data_description.max_classifications_per_day: At most this many signal types are sent to Claude automatically in 24 hours

send_signal.name: Send signal

send_raw.name: Send raw command

line.name: Command
line.description: Command line without the leading ^, e.g. F433.92 to change the receive frequency.

classify_unknown_signal.name: Classify unknown signal
